**Answer: 65**

Write $g(N)=\lfloor N/3\rfloor-\lfloor N/5\rfloor-\lfloor N/7\rfloor+\lfloor N/35\rfloor$. A solution is a value of $N$ with $g(N)=0$.

**Upper bound.** Using $\lfloor x\rfloor = x-\{x\}$ and $\frac13-\frac15-\frac17+\frac1{35}=\frac{2}{105}$:

$$g(N)=\frac{2N}{105}-\left\{\frac N3\right\}+\left\{\frac N5\right\}+\left\{\frac N7\right\}-\left\{\frac N{35}\right\}.$$

If $g(N)=0$, then
$$\frac{2N}{105}=\left\{\frac N3\right\}-\left\{\frac N5\right\}-\left\{\frac N7\right\}+\left\{\frac N{35}\right\}<\frac23+1=\frac53,$$
so $N<87.5$. Any solution satisfies $N\le 87$.

**Checking $N=66$ to $87$.** Computing $g(N)$ directly:

| N | g | N | g | N | g |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 66 | 1 | 74 | 2 | 82 | 2 |
| 67 | 1 | 75 | 2 | 83 | 2 |
| 68 | 1 | 76 | 2 | 84 | 2 |
| 69 | 2 | 77 | 1 | 85 | 1 |
| 70 | 1 | 78 | 2 | 86 | 1 |
| 71 | 1 | 79 | 2 | 87 | 2 |
| 72 | 2 | 80 | 1 | | |
| 73 | 2 | 81 | 2 | | |

None of these is zero.

**Checking $N=65$.** $\lfloor 65/3\rfloor=21$, and $\lfloor 65/5\rfloor+\lfloor 65/7\rfloor-\lfloor 65/35\rfloor=13+9-1=21$. So $N=65$ is a solution.

Therefore the largest positive integer solution is 65.

ANSWER: 65
